2607.20848.title: Auditing Evidence Use in Medical LLM Diagnosis
2607.20848.paper_summary: Medical LLMs are often evaluated by whether they select the correct diagnosis, but diagnostic accuracy alone does not show whether the model used the case evidence appropriately. We present a behavioral audit of evidence use in medical diagnosis. For each case, we decompose patient information into evidence units, score candidate diagnoses under controlled evidence subsets, and mine low-order interactions in diagnostic margins. Because medical evidence is diagnosis-relative, the audit separates interaction discovery from failure assignment: large or negative interactions can reflect plausible differential diagnosis, while suspicious interactions require robustness checks and clinical review. We evaluate five open-weight LLMs on DDXPlus, CupCase, and MedCase. Across datasets, faithful support and differential conflict or cancellation account for most interaction strength, showing that many evidence interactions are clinically plausible rather than failures. In a DDXPlus-focused blinded five-reviewer 130-item enriched review sample, invalid or shortcut-like cases concentrate in negated or absent findings and clinically local evidence. These results show that accuracy can hide candidate evidence-use failures and motivate role-aware audits for medical LLM evaluation.
2607.20848.paper_summary_zh: 醫療大型語言模型（LLMs）通常通過是否選擇正確的診斷來進行評估，但僅僅依賴診斷準確性並不能顯示模型是否適當地使用了案例證據。<lb/>我們提出了一個關於醫療診斷中證據使用的行為審計。<lb/>對於每個案例，我們將患者信息分解為證據單元，在受控的證據子集下對候選診斷進行打分，並挖掘診斷邊際中的低階互動。<lb/>由於醫療證據是相對於診斷的，該審計將互動發現與失敗分配分開：大型或負面互動可以反映合理的鑑別診斷，而可疑的互動則需要穩健性檢查和臨床審查。<lb/>我們在DDXPlus、CupCase和MedCase上評估了五個開放權重的LLMs。<lb/>在各個數據集中，忠實支持和差異衝突或取消佔據了大多數互動強度，顯示出許多證據互動在臨床上是合理的，而不是失敗。<lb/>在以DDXPlus為重點的盲審五位審稿人的130項增強審查樣本中，無效或類似捷徑的案例集中在否定或缺失的發現和臨床局部證據中。<lb/>這些結果表明，準確性可能隱藏候選證據使用的失敗，並促使對醫療LLM評估進行角色意識的審計。
